traps.note: Count denoiser evaluations on both stacks per render; a mismatch makes the pair VOID (plan: H3 19 vs 20, LTX-2.3 8 vs 11, FLUX.3 base edit 50 vs 100).
Studio's 'max' speed tier auto-skips steps (static skip / FBCache, e.g. Qwen 25 -> ~13 computed); the default tier never skips. State the tier (settings SUMMARY A.5).
Pin DiT, TE and VAE precision on both stacks: Studio's auto picks (bf16-when-fits, hosted INT8 ConvRot) differ from the template files (settings SUMMARY B.7).

The baseline UI draws initial noise on the CPU (torch.manual_seed, bline/sample.py); Studio diffusers draws it with a GPU generator. Same seed != same noise: cross-stack LPIPS needs a shared CPU fp32 noise tensor, otherwise score each stack only against its own bf16 (h3_image.md #7; moss REPORT: 0.69 LPIPS across stacks on different samplers).
The baseline UI caches node outputs: every timed request carries a nonce (bline_graphs.apply_nonce) and must show an execution count > 0.
The template ships a prompt enhancer / upsampler; benchmarks switch it off on the baseline UI arm and send the raw prompt to both stacks.

Released H3 qkv_proj rows run per head ([q;k;v] of head 0, ...); the baseline UI's Attention splits by thirds. A baseline-UI file built from the release WITHOUT the regroup loads and renders noise (the 'BlineUI H3 decoding noise' mistake). Use Bline-Org's files or build with models.convert.h3_qkv_regroup (from scripts/vidcmp_nov5/build_bline.py h3_dit).

BlineUI-GGUF has no MiniMax-H3 architecture (loader.py:105 'Unknown model architecture'); bline_graphs refuses an H3 .gguf DiT. H3 GGUF is Studio / sd.cpp only (video_vs_bline_nov5 README:411). BlineUI-GGUF @ 6ea2651e (upstream HEAD) loader.py:12 IMG_ARCH_LIST has no H3 entry and tools/convert.py detect_arch no H3 template, so H3-Image GGUF is refused too (code-read).

Studio's diffusers H3 path ran N-1 evaluations for N steps (19 for 20) until the steps-are-evaluations fix (UNSLOTH_H3_STEP_EVALUATIONS, default on; =0 restores N-1). Every pre-fix H3 cell was 1-5% unfair (settings_audit_nov10/h3.md 2(a); h3_bline_audit/video_core.md row 5).

Template res_multistep; Studio's diffusers H3 path runs res_multistep too for non-PDD banks (video_minimax_h3_sampling.h3_sampler; Euler only for PDD / turbo banks or UNSLOTH_H3_SAMPLER=euler), so the pair matches with no exception. studio.default_sampler names it for the HTTP backend, which cannot see the per-render recipe (h3.md (b)3 predates the Studio change).
Template 864x480 (ResolutionSelector 16:9 0.4 MP) vs Studio's 1344x768 default (2.5x pixels); the tester's H1 used 960x544 on both. Pin the size (h3.md (b)1).
Template TE is NVFP4-AWQ, Studio's INT8 ConvRot: use the int8_teint8 format for a like-for-like pair (h3.md (b)2; r5 h_int8_teint8).
This graph saves PNG frames (SaveImage) + PreviewAudio, not the template's CreateVideo -> SaveVideo MP4 export; o22-h3 keeps the MP4 export. Record which ran.
Template DiT is the _pruned_ fl2va model; Studio's family default is the FULL fl2va: different models, quality not comparable (minimax_h3.py docstring).
template TE is qwen3vl_32b NVFP4-AWQ; Studio's is INT8 ConvRot (NVFP4 deliberately absent in Studio); the int8_teint8 format is the like-for-like TE
template video VAE is int8 ConvRot weights (computed fp16); Studio casts the released decoder to fp16 (+ an optional int8 decoder lever)

standing.why: the template's int8 format cannot run on the baseline UI from official sources: its text encoder qwen3vl_32b_..._nvfp4_awq has no public recipe (only a Bline-Org file, which the toolkit never fetches). int8_teint8 puts the baseline on an INT8 ConvRot text encoder built from the official release with the public tool, which is what Studio's te_quant_auto runs (INT8 ConvRot), so DiT, TE and VAE precision match like for like; the template's own TE would be a different (nvfp4) encoder on one side only
